name: David Nelson

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Nelson lists his occupation as retired and his occupational background as 25 years of retail management.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

bio.statement: His statement lists the University of Utah as his educational background.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

bio.statement: His statement lists 5 years on a budget committee in Mill City and Linn County precinct committee person as prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: 5 years budget committee, Mill City, PCP Linn County

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

bio.statement: He says he is self-funded and not a politician but a concerned citizen who decided to run because no one was standing up for Democrats in District 17.
bio.excerpt: no one was standing up for the Democrats in District 17

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: Nelson says people should be able to have affordable health care.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: He says he opposes greed and corruption and would be accountable to no outside influence or group.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: He says he believes climate change is not a hoax.
positions.excerpt: climate change is not a hoax

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: He says people should be able to choose what their family looks like.
positions.excerpt: You should be able to choose what your family looks like

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

positions.statement: He says he is a humanist who believes religion should be kept out of politics and schools.
positions.excerpt: I am a humanist who believes that religion should be kept out of politics, and our schools.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book7)

gaps: No campaign website of his own was found; the pamphlet lists a Linn County Democrats page (linncodems.org) and an email address, not fetched.
No news coverage of him was found; searches returned a different David Nelson (former state senator) which was not used.
Pamphlet text contains typos reproduced verbatim in excerpts.
